children: Silicon Valley Acquisition announced a suite of material agreements to advance its merger with EigenQ and bolster liquidity. The company secured $22.225 million in initial senior secured notes and related $12.00 warrants, with an additional $22.225 million in notes and warrants to be issued immediately before closing, and set terms for five-year convertible PubCo Notes post-merger. A second amendment to the Business Combination Agreement extends the Outside Date to June 30, 2027 and clarifies lock-up participants. The transaction is further supported by a Pledge and Security Agreement, a Registration Rights Agreement, an amendment to the insider letter enabling post-closing lock-up releases for transferred founder shares, and a founder shares transfer arrangement to the investor.
Agreement 1: Silicon Valley Acquisition Amends EigenQ Merger, Extends Outside Date to June 30, 2027
: Second Amendment to Business Combination Agreement
: Through Outside Date of Jun 30 2027 (extendable monthly with consents)
: Extend merger timeline and clarify lock-up participants
Agreement 2: Silicon Valley Acquisition Secures $44.45 Million Bridge Notes With Investor; Warrants at $12
: Securities Purchase Agreement for senior secured notes and warrants
: Initial notes mature in ~6 months; additional notes at closing
: Provide bridge financing ahead of the merger
Agreement 3: Silicon Valley Acquisition Sets Terms for Five-Year Convertible PubCo Notes Post-Closing
: Form of senior secured convertible notes (PubCo Notes)
: Refinance bridge notes into longer-term convertible debt
Agreement 4: Silicon Valley Acquisition Grants Collateral Under Pledge and Security Agreement; $25M Blocked Cash Path to Release
: Until obligations satisfied; partial collateral release upon $25M deposit
: Secure obligations under the notes financing
Agreement 5: Silicon Valley Acquisition Agrees to Registration Rights for Convertible Notes and Warrants
: Until resale registration obligations are satisfied
Agreement 6: Silicon Valley Acquisition Amends Insider Letter to Permit Lock-Up Release of Transferred Founder Shares
: Amendment No. 1 to Insider Letter Agreement
: Silicon Valley Acquisition Sponsor and Certain Directors and Officers
: Enable share transfers supporting financing and closing
Agreement 7: Silicon Valley Acquisition Arranges Transfer of Up to 1,000,000 Founder Shares to Investor
: Silicon Valley Acquisition Sponsor and Institutional Investor
: Until business combination closing for lock-up release
: Align incentives and support transaction financing
